subject: Incident notification & IRP artifacts for SIG/CAIQ review
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Harbor Financial Security Team <security@harborfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Incident notification & IRP artifacts for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Danielle / Harbor security team,

I wanted to notify you proactively about a limited, non-customer-facing authentication anomaly we observed on 2027-05-11 that affected a small subset of internal monitoring endpoints. No customer data was compromised or exfiltrated. We opened our incident response process and have completed initial containment and a preliminary forensic sweep.

Key points (high-level):
- Impact: transient token refresh failures for internal telemetry collectors between 2027-05-11 22:10 UTC and 2027-05-11 22:46 UTC.
- Customer impact: none identified; no user-facing requests were affected.
- Root cause (preliminary): misconfiguration in an auth proxy rollout which caused a small percentage of internal calls to fail and retry.
- Actions taken: rollback of the proxy change, rotated service credentials where appropriate, and increased telemetry around token refresh success rates.

Per your SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ request, attached are: redwood_IRP_v2.1.pdf (our current IRP with escalation paths), forensics_summary_05012027.zip (sanitized forensic artifacts), and sanitized_syslogs_05012027.csv (redacted logs — PII/UUIDs replaced). We redacted anything that could link to internal employee IDs.

Next steps we propose:
1) Share this preliminary packet for your compliance review.
2) Schedule a 30-minute sync to walk through the artifacts and answer questions (I can make time tomorrow morning PT).
3) We'll send a final postmortem and timeline by end of business Friday with RCA and mitigations.

If you need additional artifacts (raw packet captures, timeline granularity) please call that out and we'll provide an access-controlled link or set up a secure transfer.

Regards,

Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_IRP_v2.1.pdf (application/pdf), forensics_summary_05012027.zip (application/zip), sanitized_syslogs_05012027.csv (text/csv)

Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Final postmortem and evidence handoff — Incident closed (ref: HARB-98765)

Hi Danielle / team —

Thanks for taking the time on Friday for the walkthrough. Per our commitment, attaching the final postmortem and handoff artifacts: the Drive link and artifact index are below.

Summary (final):
- Incident window: 2027-05-11 22:10 UTC — 2027-05-11 22:46 UTC
- Root cause: misrouted config in the auth-proxy rollout; a conditional header check inadvertently rejected a subset of internal refresh requests.
- Customer risk: zero (no production-facing requests impacted).
- Mitigations: immediate rollback, strengthened canary checks in our deployment pipeline, mandatory pre-rollout auth-proxy unit checks, and an automated alert for token-refresh regression.
- Status: closed — RCA documented and mitigation tasks scheduled in our backlog (internal task IDs referenced in the postmortem).

Artifact links (access-controlled):
- Postmortem + RCA: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2bIRPpostmortem
- Evidence bundle (sanitized): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2bForensicsBundle
- Zendesk ticket: https://harbor.zendesk.com/tickets/98765

Attachments included with this message: redwood_IRP_v2.1.pdf; forensics_summary_05012027.zip; sanitized_syslogs_05012027.csv. As noted, the artifacts were sanitized and timestamps normalized to UTC. If Harbor needs raw artifacts under NDA/secure transfer, we can open an SFTP window or a short-lived signed URL with additional logging.

If you have any follow-ups or need a longer, recorded walk-through for auditors, let me know and we will schedule.

Thanks again for the quick collaboration here — appreciate it.

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
